text:
Which statement about the structure of an atom is correct?
A
It contains positively charged particles only.
B
It contains negatively charged particles only.
C
It contains no charged particles.
D
It contains positively charged particles and negatively charged particles.

options.label: A
options.text: It contains positively charged particles only.

options.label: B
options.text: It contains negatively charged particles only.

options.label: D
options.text: It contains positively charged particles and negatively charged particles.
